game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on molten golems.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on molten golems. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the damage value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about damage to power up the fire warden and open the ember furnace.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Pumice Pass'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
